provenance.scope: pair-margin polycor moments; independent lavaan scores and matrix inversion; supplied-moment DWLS plus robust scaled/shifted test; no zero-cell correction; unconstrained uniquenesses; rotation std.ov=FALSE on already standardized correlation scale
provenance.rotationStandardization: Default lavaan std.ov=TRUE outputs are retained separately. Point rotation is unchanged on a unit-diagonal model, but its bordered SE calculation gives different results for oblique rotations. Native uses the full loading-to-rotation map without an additional observed-variable rescaling.

oblimin.method: Independent R numDeriv Richardson r=3 eps=.004 on offsets scaled by 1+abs(theta); QR orientation; full GPArotation/stats rotation map; varimax eps=1e-14; N-1 denominator
